author: EFE Security Team
_comment: OpenVEX 0.2.0 baseline statement for EFE v1.0.0 GA. This document attests the exploitability state of every applicable known vulnerability against the v1.0.0 product set at GA release time. The full feed (including future yanks and CVE assessments) lives at docs/security/vex/feed.json.

vulnerability.name: EFE-V1.0.0-GA-BASELINE
vulnerability.description: EFE v1.0.0 General Availability — baseline VEX statement. No known HIGH or CRITICAL CVEs affect this product set at release time. Trivy and Grype scans pass clean. Subsequent CVE disclosures will be appended to docs/security/vex/feed.json with per-CVE statements.

statements.impact_statement: EFE v1.0.0 ships with a clean security baseline at GA release time. No HIGH or CRITICAL CVEs apply. The product set has been scanned with Trivy 0.51+ and Grype 0.78+ and ships SBOM (CycloneDX 1.5) embedded in every Docker image. SLSA-3 provenance is generated by GitHub-hosted runners.
statements.action_statement: Subscribe to the security RSS feed (https://efe.example.com/security/feed.xml) for future advisories. Verify any artifact via cosign : https://github.com/efe-ai/efe/blob/v1.0.0/docs/release/VERIFY_RELEASE.md
